SCOPE OF WORK FOR REWINDING OF RAW WATER PUMP MOTOR
1. The motor to be taken from site for rewinding & repairing.
2. Rewinding to be carried out with new copper coils in all three phases and with F class
insulation.
3. New bearings SKF 6212 C3 to be replaced both DE and NDE side. The test and
warranty certificates for the bearings are to be produced
4. Any machining cost that may be required in motor servicing to be done in contractor
scope
5. The terminal block / insulators of the motor if found damaged to be replaced.
6. Motor space heater if found not working to be replaced.
7-. IF the cooling fan of the motor found in damaged condition it should be replaced
under contractor's scope.
8. All spares and consumables required for rewinding and servicing of the motor is
under contractor's scope.
9. Necessary routine tests, Insulation test, winding resistance, no load test on the motor
to be carried out and report submitted.
1O. The contractor should provided performance and service guarantee for the period of
minimum six months.
1 1. Two coats of Painting (Smoke Grey Color) of the motor to be carried out.
12. The motor after completion of servicing to be delivered at site.
13. If any abnormal sound /overheating/abnormal current observed at no load and full
load condition it has to be rectified by the contractor at their own cost for smooth
operation.
14.In case of any faulty workmanship in the above scope of work, the party must rectify
the same at their own cost.
